sample_type.evidence_source: [/page/3/Text/5] The data collection design was based on schools in the province of Girona (Catalonia, north-east Spain), including staterun and private schools located in rural, semi-urban and urban municipal areas. Initial contact was aimed at identifying schools whose head teacher would allow us to visit the school every year over a 5-year period to administer a questionnaire to children in one or two classrooms – the same group(s) each year. A total of 16 schools in 9 different municipal areas agreed to participate.
